name: Ghost-o-plasm Round Up
summary: Hornizz Brimbuzzle sends you into the Valley of Bones for ghost energy, hoping the Magram will pay well for it.

sections.title: A Haunted Valley
sections.body: Hornizz Brimbuzzle sends you southeast to the Valley of Bones, where Magram ghosts walk. The valley sounds frightening to him. Yet he thinks the spirits must frighten the Magram even more, and he is sure the centaurs would pay well for ghost energy captured there.

sections.title: Between the Dead Goliaths
sections.body: Hornizz Brimbuzzle gives you a crate of ghost magnets. Set one between the two huge skeletons called the Dead Goliaths, and it draws the ghosts toward it. The spirits yield ghost-o-plasm, which Hornizz plans to sell to the Magram. He asks you to bring him eight ghost-o-plasms and the crate.

sections.title: Back with the Haul
sections.body: Hornizz Brimbuzzle sees ghost-o-plasm rubbed onto you when you return and calls it slimy. He reckons it could make a fortune if the centaurs can be persuaded of what it is.

faq.answer: Hornizz Brimbuzzle keeps a camp southwest of the Kodo Graveyard in Desolace. He wants to sell ghost energy to the Magram centaurs.

faq.q: Where is the Valley of Bones?
aliases: where do i find the ghosts
faq.answer: The Valley of Bones lies southeast of Hornizz Brimbuzzle. The two Dead Goliaths stand at the valley's southern end. They are the great skeletons where you set the magnet.
Hornizz Brimbuzzle believes the Magram centaurs will pay well for ghost energy captured in the haunted Valley of Bones. He plans to sell them ghost-o-plasm.

faq.q: How does the ghost magnet work?
faq.answer: Set a ghost magnet between the two Dead Goliaths, and it draws the valley's ghosts toward it. The spirits yield ghost-o-plasm.
